body:
The work needs changes in camcraft-ui and camcraft-app.
The issue requires the display choice to use the existing saved view settings.
crates/app/src/view.rs defines ViewPrefs and saves show_gizmo_names.
crates/ui/src/state_view.rs loads and saves that structure.
The fix must extend that structure and its old-file and round-trip tests.
It must also change the renderer, Browser controls, picking, and wasm callers.

Raised effort:medium to effort:high under the work-issue escalation rule.
No claim, branch, code change, or test run exists for this attempt.

The local upstream/main reference is 744c0847. It still defines only two display modes.
The existing feature picker sorts cursor distance first and camera depth second.
The see-through mode can use its existing through option.

PR #2786 changes browser(), which also contains the display controls.
A future worker must check that PR and stack if it remains open and eligible.
PRs #2783 and #2662 also touch viewport_bar.rs.
Check their changed functions before the toolbar update.
Other same-file overlaps include #2773, #2770, #2764, #2763, #2737, #2678, #2663, #2554, and #2149.
